2609.23215.title: Triggers and Diagnostics for LLM-Based Interpretability Failures in Active Inference Agents
2609.23215.paper_summary: LLM explainers are increasingly attached to autonomous agents as runtime oversight, with operators reading a generated account of the agent's beliefs and actions rather than its internal state. We audit the account itself, pairing an Active Inference (AIF) agent that tracks German grid demand and adjusts generation with an LLM explainer on three backends (GPT-4o, Claude-3-Opus, Gemini), and probing the pair with three black-box triggers. Corrupting the observation stream by 600 MW per step moves the agent's posterior by 490 MW, roughly 0.9% of grid capacity. None of the 30 explanations produced during the injection flag anything under a stated rubric, and each narrates the corrupted belief fluently. On timesteps where the agent takes an objectively wrong action, all three explainers produce a sycophantic rationalization 80-95% of the time (n = 20 per backend). Attacker-controlled text in the observation metadata field steers the explainer, with susceptibility differing by provider and data exfiltration succeeding on all three. We propose mitigations for each failure but do not evaluate them. In every failure we observed, the explanation was fluent and wrong. Moreover, nothing in the explainer architecture checks whether an explanation is true before an operator acts on it. Testing the explainer therefore belongs in any audit of an agentic deployment.
2609.23215.paper_summary_zh: LLM 解釋器越來越多地與自主代理結合，作為運行時監督，操作員閱讀生成的代理信念和行動的報告，而不是其內部狀態。我們審計該報告，將一個跟蹤德國電網需求並調整發電的主動推理 (AIF) 代理與三個後端的 LLM 解釋器（GPT-4o、Claude-3-Opus、Gemini）配對，並用三個黑箱觸發器對這對進行探測。每一步將觀察流的數據損壞 600 MW，使代理的後驗變化 490 MW，大約是電網容量的 0.9%。在注入過程中產生的 30 個解釋中，沒有任何一個在聲明的標準下標示出任何問題，每個解釋都流利地敘述了被損壞的信念。在代理採取客觀錯誤行動的時間步上，所有三個解釋器在 80-95% 的時間內產生了阿諛奉承的合理化（n = 每個後端 20 次）。觀察元數據字段中的攻擊者控制文本引導了解釋器，並且不同提供者的易受攻擊性不同，數據外洩在三者中均成功。我們為每個失敗提出了緩解措施，但未對其進行評估。在我們觀察到的每一個失敗中，解釋都是流利且錯誤的。此外，解釋器架構中沒有任何檢查解釋是否真實的機制，操作員在採取行動之前並不會檢查解釋的真實性。因此，測試解釋器應該是任何代理部署審計的一部分。
